description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Polgahaange, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District (25/5514103)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and declarations of land ownership determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific land parcel details, owner information, cadastral references, and legal declarations regarding land titles, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
